program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
source_target_name: VA or VHA PLTSS bills-of-collection and debt-management materials
source_target_scope: Find whether incorrect-amount PLTSS post-payment review findings are converted into bills of collection, receivables, debts, recoveries, offsets, or other collectible-dollar amounts.
evidence_to_extract: connection to PLTSS improper and unknown payment estimate
negative_evidence_rule: If the source only describes post-payment review or bills-of-collection process without PLTSS-specific recoverable or collectible dollars, keep field closure and scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate progress source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
source_target_name: VA or VHA PLTSS medical-review recoverability category materials
source_target_scope: Find whether PLTSS documentation, timeliness, technical, unknown-payment, non-recoverable, and incorrect-amount categories are separated for recoverability or collection treatment.
evidence_to_extract: connection to bills of collection or collectible overpayments
negative_evidence_rule: If the source mixes documentation defects, technical errors, timeliness errors, unknown payments, and recoverable overpayments without a PLTSS-specific recoverability split, keep scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate progress source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.
